edits.content: lhs: Literal, rhs: Literal)(implicit pos: Position): Option[Literal] = {

(op: @switch) match {
      case === => Some(BooleanLiteral(literal_===(lhs, rhs, isJSStrictEq = false)))
      case !== => Some(BooleanLiteral(!literal_===(lhs, rhs, isJSStrictEq = false)))

      case String_+ =>
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
            "constFoldBinaryOp_except_String_+ must not be called for String_+")

      case Int_+ => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) + int(rhs)))
      case Int_- => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) - int(rhs)))
      case Int_* => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) * int(rhs)))
      case Int_/ => if (int(rhs) == 0) None else Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) / int(rhs)))
      case Int_% => if (int(rhs) == 0) None else Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) % int(rhs)))

      case Int_|   => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) | int(rhs)))
      case Int_&   => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) & int(rhs)))
      case Int_^   => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) ^ int(rhs)))
      case Int_<<  => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) << int(rhs)))
      case Int_>>> => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) >>> int(rhs)))
      case Int_>>  => Some(IntLiteral(int(lhs) >> int(rhs)))

      case Int_== => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) == int(rhs)))
      case Int_!= => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) != int(rhs)))
      case Int_<  => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) < int(rhs)))
      case Int_<= => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) <= int(rhs)))
      case Int_>  => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) > int(rhs)))
      case Int_>= => Some(BooleanLiteral(int(lhs) >= int(rhs)))

      case Long_+ => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) + long(rhs)))
      case Long_- => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) - long(rhs)))
      case Long_* => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) * long(rhs)))
      case Long_/ => if (long(rhs) == 0L) None else Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) / long(rhs)))
      case Long_% => if (long(rhs) == 0L) None else Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) % long(rhs)))

      case Long_|   => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) | long(rhs)))
      case Long_&   => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) & long(rhs)))
      case Long_^   => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) ^ long(rhs)))
      case Long_<<  => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) << int(rhs)))
      case Long_>>> => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) >>> int(rhs)))
      case Long_>>  => Some(LongLiteral(long(lhs) >> int(rhs)))

      case Long_== => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) == long(rhs)))
      case Long_!= => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) != long(rhs)))
      case Long_<  => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) < long(rhs)))
      case Long_<= => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) <= long(rhs)))
      case Long_>  => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) > long(rhs)))
      case Long_>= => Some(BooleanLiteral(long(lhs) >= long(rhs)))

      case Float_+ => Some(FloatLiteral(float(lhs) + float(rhs)))
      case Float_- => Some(FloatLiteral(float(lhs) - float(rhs)))
      case Float_* => Some(FloatLiteral(float(lhs) * float(rhs)))
      case Float_/ => Some(FloatLiteral(float(lhs) / float(rhs)))
      case Float_% => Some(FloatLiteral(float(lhs) % float(rhs)))

      case Double_+ => Some(DoubleLiteral(double(lhs) + double(rhs)))
      case Double_- => Some(DoubleLiteral(double(lhs) - double(rhs)))
      case Double_* => Some(DoubleLiteral(double(lhs) * double(rhs)))
      case Double_/ => Some(DoubleLiteral(double(lhs) / double(rhs)))
      case Double_% => Some(DoubleLiteral(double(lhs) % double(rhs)))

      case Double_== => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) == double(rhs)))
      case Double_!= => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) != double(rhs)))
      case Double_<  => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) < double(rhs)))
      case Double_<= => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) <= double(rhs)))
      case Double_>  => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) > double(rhs)))
      case Double_>= => Some(BooleanLiteral(double(lhs) >= double(rhs)))

      case Boolean_== => Some(BooleanLiteral(boolean(lhs) == boolean(rhs)))
      case Boolean_!= => Some(BooleanLiteral(boolean(lhs) != boolean(rhs)))
      case Boolean_|  => Some(BooleanLiteral(boolean(lhs) | boolean(rhs)))
      case Boolean_&  => Some(BooleanLiteral(boolean(lhs) & boolean(rhs)))

      case String_charAt =>
        val str = string(lhs)
        val idx = int(rhs)
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= str.length()) None
        else Some(CharLiteral(str.charAt(idx)))
    }
